note: source_row = 0-based data row index in the member file (header excluded). The subsets are documented by these row lists.

feature_docs.Name: srcip
feature_docs.Description: Source IP address

feature_docs.Name: sport
feature_docs.Description: Source port number

feature_docs.Name: dstip
feature_docs.Description: Destination IP address

feature_docs.Name: dsport
feature_docs.Description: Destination port number

feature_docs.Name: proto
feature_docs.Description: Transaction protocol

feature_docs.Name: state
feature_docs.Description: Indicates to the state and its dependent protocol, e.g. ACC, CLO, CON, ECO, ECR, FIN, INT, MAS, PAR, REQ, RST, TST, TXD, URH, URN, and (-) (if not used state)

feature_docs.Name: dur
feature_docs.Description: Record total duration

feature_docs.Name: sbytes
feature_docs.Description: Source to destination transaction bytes

feature_docs.Name: dbytes
feature_docs.Description: Destination to source transaction bytes

feature_docs.Name: sttl
feature_docs.Description: Source to destination time to live value

feature_docs.Name: dttl
feature_docs.Description: Destination to source time to live value

feature_docs.Name: sloss
feature_docs.Description: Source packets retransmitted or dropped

feature_docs.Name: dloss
feature_docs.Description: Destination packets retransmitted or dropped

feature_docs.Name: service
feature_docs.Description: http, ftp, smtp, ssh, dns, ftp-data ,irc  and (-) if not much used service

feature_docs.Name: Sload
feature_docs.Description: Source bits per second

feature_docs.Name: Dload
feature_docs.Description: Destination bits per second

feature_docs.Name: Spkts
feature_docs.Description: Source to destination packet count

feature_docs.Name: Dpkts
feature_docs.Description: Destination to source packet count

feature_docs.Name: swin
feature_docs.Description: Source TCP window advertisement value

feature_docs.Name: dwin
feature_docs.Description: Destination TCP window advertisement value

feature_docs.Name: stcpb
feature_docs.Description: Source TCP base sequence number

feature_docs.Name: dtcpb
feature_docs.Description: Destination TCP base sequence number

feature_docs.Name: smeansz
feature_docs.Description: Mean of the ?ow packet size transmitted by the src

feature_docs.Name: dmeansz
feature_docs.Description: Mean of the ?ow packet size transmitted by the dst

feature_docs.Name: trans_depth
feature_docs.Description: Represents the pipelined depth into the connection of http request/response transaction

feature_docs.Name: res_bdy_len
feature_docs.Description: Actual uncompressed content size of the data transferred from the servers http service.

feature_docs.Name: Sjit
feature_docs.Description: Source jitter (mSec)

feature_docs.Name: Djit
feature_docs.Description: Destination jitter (mSec)

feature_docs.Name: Stime
feature_docs.Description: record start time

feature_docs.Name: Ltime
feature_docs.Description: record last time

feature_docs.Name: Sintpkt
feature_docs.Description: Source interpacket arrival time (mSec)

feature_docs.Name: Dintpkt
feature_docs.Description: Destination interpacket arrival time (mSec)

feature_docs.Name: tcprtt
feature_docs.Description: TCP connection setup round-trip time, the sum of synack and ackdat.

feature_docs.Name: synack
feature_docs.Description: TCP connection setup time, the time between the SYN and the SYN_ACK packets.

feature_docs.Name: ackdat
feature_docs.Description: TCP connection setup time, the time between the SYN_ACK and the ACK packets.

feature_docs.Name: is_sm_ips_ports
feature_docs.Description: If source (1) and destination (3)IP addresses equal and port numbers (2)(4)  equal then, this variable takes value 1 else 0

feature_docs.Name: ct_state_ttl
feature_docs.Description: No. for each state (6) according to specific range of values for source/destination time to live (10) (11).

feature_docs.Name: ct_flw_http_mthd
feature_docs.Description: No. of flows that has methods such as Get and Post in http service.

feature_docs.Name: is_ftp_login
feature_docs.Description: If the ftp session is accessed by user and password then 1 else 0.

feature_docs.Name: ct_ftp_cmd
feature_docs.Description: No of flows that has a command in ftp session.

feature_docs.Name: ct_srv_src
feature_docs.Description: No. of connections that contain the same service (14) and source address (1) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_srv_dst
feature_docs.Description: No. of connections that contain the same service (14) and destination address (3) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_dst_ltm
feature_docs.Description: No. of connections of the same destination address (3) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_src_ ltm
feature_docs.Description: No. of connections of the same source address (1) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_src_dport_ltm
feature_docs.Description: No of connections of the same source address (1) and the destination port (4) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_dst_sport_ltm
feature_docs.Description: No of connections of the same destination address (3) and the source port (2) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: ct_dst_src_ltm
feature_docs.Description: No of connections of the same source (1) and the destination (3) address in in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

feature_docs.Name: attack_cat
feature_docs.Description: The name of each attack category. In this data set , nine categories e.g. Fuzzers, Analysis, Backdoors, DoS Exploits, Generic, Reconnaissance, Shellcode and Worms

feature_docs.Name: Label
feature_docs.Description: 0 for normal and 1 for attack records

data_quality_notes: four dsport values (ICMP rows) are stored in hexadecimal in the release (e.g. 0xcc09); prepare_data.py parses them to integers
attack_cat in the release carries leading spaces (e.g. ' Fuzzers') and two spellings 'Backdoor' / 'Backdoors'; the original column is kept (it stratifies the split) and attack_type harmonises them
UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv / testing-set.csv (no IP addresses) are not used; the subset comes from UNSW-NB15_1..4.csv
the release contains exact duplicate rows; source_row lists the first unused identical row in file order
